if (cacheParams.prefetch.isEmpty) {
val sourceCount = 1 << io.in.b.bits.source.getWidth
val probePending = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(sourceCount)(false.B)))
val probeAddress = Reg(Vec(sourceCount, UInt(io.in.b.bits.address.getWidth.W)))
val probeFire = io.in.b.fire && io.in.b.bits.opcode === Probe
val probeAckFire = io.in.c.fire && (io.in.c.bits.opcode === ProbeAck || io.in.c.bits.opcode === ProbeAckData)
val probeAckMissingPending = probeAckFire && !probePending(io.in.c.bits.source)
val probeAckAddressMismatch = probeAckFire && probePending(io.in.c.bits.source) && probeAddress(io.in.c.bits.source) =/= io.in.c.bits.address
val probeAckViolation = probeAckMissingPending || probeAckAddressMismatch
when(probeFire) { probePending(io.in.b.bits.source) := true.B; probeAddress(io.in.b.bits.source) := io.in.b.bits.address }
when(probeAckFire) { probePending(io.in.c.bits.source) := false.B }
chisel3.util.experimental.BoringUtils.addSource(probeAckMissingPending, s"${cacheParams.name}_{{source_label}}_probe_missing", disableDedup = true)
chisel3.util.experimental.BoringUtils.addSource(probeAckAddressMismatch, s"${cacheParams.name}_{{source_label}}_probe_address", disableDedup = true)
chisel3.util.experimental.BoringUtils.addSource(probeAckViolation, s"${cacheParams.name}_{{source_label}}_probe_combined", disableDedup = true)
}
